proposals.title: Proposal 6 — Stockholder Proposal Requesting the Elimination of Supermajority Voting Requirements
proposals.proponent: James McRitchie and Myra K. Young
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board eliminate charter and bylaw voting requirements above a simple majority, replacing them with a majority of votes cast for and against.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors Recommends a Vote AGAINST Proposal 6.

proposals.title: Proposal 7 — Stockholder Proposal Requesting a Report on Salesforce's Criteria for Investing in, Operating in and Withdrawing from High-Risk Regions
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report, excluding proprietary information and due by December 2018, identifying criteria for investing in, operating in and withdrawing from high-risk regions with human rights concerns.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors Recommends a Vote AGAINST Proposal 7.
